instruction: Compare Apple Watch Ultra 2 with Apple Watch Series 9 and Apple Watch SE

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing 3 Apple Watch models on Apple's website. Evaluator checks that the active tab URL contains the modelList parameter with the 3 specified Apple Watch models (order-independent). Similar complexity to original task, just different product category.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree and parses modelList query parameter
Metric appropriately compares extracted modelList against expected 3 Apple Watch models with order-independent comparison
Expected values are semantically correct (apple-watch-ultra-2, apple-watch-series-9, apple-watch-se match typical Apple URL patterns)
Evaluator provides complete coverage - verifies all 3 models are present in the comparison URL
Logic will work correctly at runtime - getter can extract URL parameters and metric can compare lists with ignore_list_order
No logical edge cases or semantic issues identified
